product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Silicone Collapsible Colander
features: Colander stands securely upright and has raised feet for effective rinsing and draining
Collapses flat for easy storage; Silicone Colander is heat-resistant to 600ºF and safe for use with non-stick cookware
Can be immersed in boiling water to quickly blanch vegetables like broccoli, green beans, spinach and more
Also great for traditional uses like draining pasta and rinsing fruits and vegetables; Non-slip handles provide firm grip while shaking
Collapsed dimensions: 13" x 9.25" x 1.75"; Dishwasher safe
description: Oxo’s Good Grips 9-inch silicone colander collapses for easy storage, yet stands up to all your straining tasks. It stands securely upright when expanded, making it ideal for draining pasta and rinsing fruits and vegetables. It can also be immersed in boiling water to quickly blanch or parboil vegetables. Nonslip handles provide a firm grip while transporting and shaking. When collapsed, the colander is less than two inches in height and fits easily inside the dishwasher and kitchen drawers or cabinets. Simply press the center to expand the colander. With hands on the outer rim, push the center back in to collapse it. At 3-1/2-quart capacity and 9 inches in diameter, the colander fits well inside standard five- and six-quart quart stockpots. This colander can be washed in the dishwasher.
